You're saying if I use eruption and then swap to a weapon, and grease, it will apply the effect through eruptions damage?

That's what the code reading predicts, but nobody has tested it. The Eruption bullet copies its attack's elemental and status fields from the right-hand weapon slot at the moment each lava burst spawns, not at the moment the skill starts, so a weapon swapped in after the cast and then greased would hand its grease buff to every burst spawned after the swap. The buff rides on the SpEffect attached to the weapon, and the bullet's behaviour param reads that SpEffect through the same accessor the melee hitbox uses, which is why Piquebone's arrows behave the same way. What could break it is the swap animation itself: if the last burst spawns before the swap finishes, none of them see the new weapon, and the timing of that window has never been measured on this build.
